question: compute/trumvps identity_cost.kind is 'email' with the detail 'unverified: the sign-up form was not read'; should it be 'any-phone', since the sign-up form marks a phone number as required?
why: The sign-up page at https://support.trumvps.vn/signup/ marks an email address, a password, a first and last name, an address, a country and a phone number as required, plus a captcha (capture sha256:20c34b4ca32799de36bdb3dca016c771f42d95f8df87428919314b77c7e56626, quote 'Điện thoại \*'). The existing record's kind defaults to email because the form was never read. The unit's scope is new records only, so the field cannot be set here.
